objective: Expose dataForge's snowflakeCost pack through dashForge's generate CLI and snapshot packager, producing deterministic SQLite databases and JSON snapshots with provenance and recommendation queues for Snowflake cost buyer demos.

journeys.name: Generate deterministic Snowflake cost idle warehouse SQLite database and JSON snapshot
journeys.goal: An author or consultant generates a deterministic Snowflake cost database and JSON snapshot for the idle-warehouse-waste scenario with seed 9101, producing reproducible SQLite tables, canonical snapshot datasets, and rich provenance metadata for an executive buyer demo.
commands: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario idle-warehouse-waste --seed 9101 --output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.snapshot.json --force
steps: Execute env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario idle-warehouse-waste --seed 9101 --output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.snapshot.json --force.
Confirm the command exits with code 0 and creates both the SQLite database file and the snapshot JSON file.
Verify the exported snapshot conforms to the SQLiteSnapshot schema, containing the 7 expected dataset exports with intact row records.

Verify provenance metadata fields (packId, scenarioId, seed, dataForgeStoryContractPath, generatorVersion, generationTimestamp, synthetic, disclosure) and recommendation queue severity and action columns.

journeys.name: Fail closed when target database or snapshot output path already exists without force flag
journeys.goal: An operator confirms that existing output files are protected against accidental overwrites by failing closed with exit code 2 unless --force is explicitly provided.
commands: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario idle-warehouse-waste --output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.sqlite
env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario idle-warehouse-waste --output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.sqlite --force
steps: Attempt to generate to an existing output path without passing --force using env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario idle-warehouse-waste --output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.sqlite.
Confirm the command exits with status 2 and outputs a clean diagnostic error indicating that output files already exist.

Re-run the command with --force using env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario idle-warehouse-waste --output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.sqlite --force and confirm successful generation.

journeys.name: Generate multiple Snowflake cost pack scenarios dynamically discovered from dataForge
journeys.goal: A mission verifies that the CLI discovers scenarios dynamically from dataForge rather than hardcoding them, generating deterministic databases and snapshots across multiple cost stories such as bi-over-provisioning and finops-maturity-assessment.
commands: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario bi-over-provisioning --seed 9102 --output /tmp/bi-over-provisioning.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/bi-over-provisioning.snapshot.json --force

env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario finops-maturity-assessment --seed 9106 --output /tmp/finops-maturity.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/finops-maturity.snapshot.json --force
steps: Execute env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate with --pack snowflakeCost --scenario bi-over-provisioning --seed 9102 --output /tmp/bi-over-provisioning.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/bi-over-provisioning.snapshot.json --force.

Execute env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate with --pack snowflakeCost --scenario finops-maturity-assessment --seed 9106 --output /tmp/finops-maturity.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/finops-maturity.snapshot.json --force.
Confirm both dynamically discovered scenarios succeed with exit code 0 and produce valid SQLite tables and snapshot JSON structures.

journeys.name: Verify recommendation queue schema and synthetic disclosure provenance metadata
journeys.goal: A human consultant or reviewer inspects the generated snapshot artifacts for idle-warehouse-waste to ensure governance columns (executive_severity, suggested_owner, recommended_action, evidence_detail, guardrail) and synthetic disclosure metadata are fully preserved.
commands: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario idle-warehouse-waste --seed 9101 --output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.snapshot.json --force
steps: Run env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario idle-warehouse-waste --seed 9101 --output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/idle-warehouse-waste.snapshot.json --force.
Inspect the exported snapshot JSON metadata to confirm synthetic: true and disclosure: 'Synthetic demo data' are present alongside dataForge story contract path and timestamp.
Inspect the recommendation_queue dataset to confirm executive_severity, suggested_owner, recommended_action, evidence_detail, and guardrail columns are present with valid data.

journeys.name: Handle invalid scenario identifiers and missing CLI arguments gracefully without tracebacks
journeys.goal: A human user verifies that invalid scenario names, unsupported packs, or missing required parameters fail closed with exit code 2 and concise diagnostic error messages without raw Python tracebacks.
commands: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack snowflakeCost --scenario non-existent-cost-scenario --output /tmp/non-existent.sqlite
steps: Run env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate with an unknown scenario name under --pack snowflakeCost.
Confirm the command exits with exit code 2 and outputs a clean diagnostic error without unhandled tracebacks.
Run env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main without arguments and verify exit code 2 with standard usage diagnostics.

journeys.name: Verify regression immunity for existing packs and execute full automated test suite
journeys.goal: A human reviewer executes existing pack generation and the complete automated test suite to confirm backwards compatibility and data adapter schema conformance with no regressions.
commands: env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack healthcare --scenario flu-season --seed 3101 --output /tmp/healthcare-flu.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/healthcare-flu.snapshot.json --force
steps: Generate a healthcare pack scenario using env PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m dashForge.main generate --pack healthcare --scenario flu-season --seed 3101 --output /tmp/healthcare-flu.sqlite --snapshot-output /tmp/healthcare-flu.snapshot.json --force and verify exit code 0.
Execute python3 -m pytest tests/ -q with no PYTHONPATH override from workspace root.
Confirm all automated tests pass cleanly, verifying determinism, dataset export resolution, and schema compatibility across all packs.
